title: THE NATHAN TABOR METHOD — Complete Personal Intelligence Ecosystem Map
creator: John Nathan Tabor
product: MAKE AI YOURS — powered by NATHAN AI
artifact_type: independent architecture map, not a deployment record

principles.name: SOURCE FIRST
principles.implementation_contract: Store byte-identical originals; link corrections/interpretations without replacing them.

principles.name: MEMORY AS STRUCTURE
principles.implementation_contract: Use entities, timestamps, relationships, source IDs, and cross-reference graph.

principles.name: ROOT-LEVEL ANALYSIS
principles.implementation_contract: Run attributed phonetic/letter/root transformations as derived records.

principles.name: DETERMINISTIC CONTROL
principles.implementation_contract: Treat BUILD/CLEAR operations as specified, tested procedures; 1+1 can build a tool that clears.

principles.name: CONTINUOUS CREATION
principles.implementation_contract: Turn approved records into separately versioned books, apps, games, and research.

principles.name: MULTI-AI COMPUTATION
principles.implementation_contract: Explicit, owner-reviewed handoffs; prohibit implied continuous sync.

principles.name: ORIGINAL-IDENTITY PRESERVATION
principles.implementation_contract: Distinct namespaces, exact titles, historical versions, non-destructive linking.

principles.name: MOBILE-FIRST OPERATION
principles.implementation_contract: Phone capture, laptop diagnostics and bulk operations.

principles.name: VERIFIABLE RECOVERY
principles.implementation_contract: Hash every source, export off-device backups, restore in a separate profile/device.

principles.name: TEACH THE METHOD
principles.implementation_contract: Onboarding, practical exercises, source ownership, transferable workflow.

modules.name: PERSON / CREATOR
modules.purpose: Owns original material, decides what is shared, authorizes transformations and releases.

modules.name: PHONE / VOICE PORTAL
modules.purpose: Mobile-first capture of voice transcription, images, notes, and commands.

modules.name: LAPTOP / DESKTOP
modules.purpose: Bulk file review, local source access, code testing, data migrations, backups and recovery checks.

modules.name: CERO 0.0 / SOURCE INTAKE
modules.purpose: Keep original bytes, text, language, timestamps and identity. Source is never overwritten by interpretations.

modules.name: UNIVERSAL CREATOR VAULT
modules.purpose: Stores original file and image bytes in local browser IndexedDB; exports full-byte ZIP backups.

modules.name: VAULT BACKUP / RECOVERY ENGINE
modules.purpose: SHA-256 and ZIP integrity verification, owner-triggered export, non-destructive restore. Off-device backup and restore testing remain user responsibilities.

modules.name: TABOR-ROOT / SOURCE REGISTRY
modules.purpose: Canonical identity, source lineage, project/version identity, permissions, audit, policy, and operation provenance.

modules.name: NATHAN AI
modules.purpose: Umbrella coordination, application navigation, agent/tool handoff and person-controlled orchestration.

modules.name: NATHAN OS
modules.purpose: Personal operating layer and terminal vision. Current implementation is user-level browser software, not a native OS kernel.

modules.name: ONE — THE LAST APP
modules.purpose: Personal command center connecting notes, files, other applications and authorized tools without erasing their identities.

modules.name: MAKE AI YOURS
modules.purpose: Installable phone-first PWA with eight teaching stages, source capture, typed notes, owner-reviewed AI handoffs and recovery exercises.

modules.name: MEMORY MATRIX / meSPARK
modules.purpose: Structured linked records with source/working/interpretation/fiction types, project references and tags; local browser memory notes.

modules.name: KNOWLEDGE ENGINE
modules.purpose: Indexing, contextual search, historical evidence, claimed-versus-verified labels, maps, numbers and cross-references.

modules.name: WORDS / PHONETIC & ROOT ENGINE
modules.purpose: Letter, sound, root, rotation, reversal, mirrored and multi-language exploration; derived readings must not replace source text.

modules.name: PERSONAL INTELLIGENCE MINDS ATLAS
modules.purpose: Read-only catalog of documented source-defined personas, virtual namespaces, historical research lenses, Cero/Uno/Dos and proposed cross-links.

modules.name: OMNI 126B ADDRESS NAMESPACE
modules.purpose: 126,000,000,000 virtual numeric addresses and 20 source-named personas. Not 126B running agents or literal historical minds.

modules.name: 732m SUPERNODES
modules.purpose: Separate 732,000,000 logical node namespace, with conceptual per-node identity and access/memory rules; not physical machines.

modules.name: COMPLETE MIND / HISTORICAL LENSES
modules.purpose: Author-role and documentary study lenses; preserve typed boundaries between historical text, interpretation, simulation and fiction.

modules.name: MULTI-AI GATEWAY / LOCAL MCP
modules.purpose: Manual, owner-reviewed metadata-first JSON handoffs and optional read-only local stdio MCP for one approved directory. No automatic provider sync.

modules.name: MCP SOURCE BRIDGE
modules.purpose: Optional read-only local adapter for authorized files/images; browser Vault files require deliberate export/import first.

modules.name: TABOR 1-2-3 FACTORY
modules.purpose: CREATE → TRANSFORM → PUBLISH, with distinct ACT, STORY, ART responsibilities and source-preserving derivatives.

modules.name: CREATIVE OUTPUTS & LIBRARY
modules.purpose: Manuscripts, research indexes, applications, games, websites and teaching assets; releases get independent versions and provenance.

modules.name: AUDIT & TEST EVIDENCE
modules.purpose: Log imports, saves, handoffs, exports and restores. Distinguish passing tests from deployment claims and planned functions.

modules.name: TEACH THE METHOD
modules.purpose: Eight-stage learning journey: Own → Capture → Organize → Preserve → Configure → Connect → Create → Recover.

verified_pull_requests.scope: phone-first PWA, source import, Vault bridge, local notes, full-byte backup, optional read-only MCP
read-only Minds Atlas, virtual namespace mapping, study lenses, proposed cross-links

technology_boundaries: Browser IndexedDB data is tied to a browser profile, not cross-device shared storage.
Manual AI handoff is not automated model-account sync.
Read-only MCP requires deliberate user directory selection and client configuration.
126B Omni and 732m SUPERNODES are separate logical namespace counts; they do not count live agents or servers.
Merged source code does not imply passing CI or production readiness.
Do not publish private originals, credentials, precise locations or private family records in a public repository.
